title: Inventory: Bloom et al. 2013 (Nature 494:234) supplementary information
intro: Generated by `ingest/inventory.py` from `sources/bloom2013/raw/`: every item listed under
downloaded from static-content.springer.com on 2026-11-01, untouched. Nature's PowerPoint copies of
the five main figures are not supplementary data and were not downloaded. The article page is kept
as `sources/bloom2013/article.html`; it is paywalled and carries the abstract, the supplement
captions, references and change history, but not the main text or Online Methods.

roles.41586_2013_BFnature11867_MOESM85_ESM.pdf: Supplementary Information: Supplementary Figures 1-4 and a link to additional data and code (http://genomics-pubs.princeton.edu/YeastCross_BYxRM/, not reachable from the build environment).
roles.41586_2013_BFnature11867_MOESM86_ESM.xls: Supplementary Table 1: drug doses, heritability statistics, and QTL summary statistics for each of the 46 traits.
roles.41586_2013_BFnature11867_MOESM87_ESM.xls: Supplementary Table 2: additive genetic variance partitioned by chromosome for each trait.
roles.41586_2013_BFnature11867_MOESM88_ESM.xls: Supplementary Table 3: detected QTL (core input): trait, fraction of phenotypic variance explained, chromosome, peak position, LOD, 1.5-LOD confidence interval, and genes under the interval.

missing: The main text and Online Methods (paywalled on the article page): QTL detection procedure, threshold, and how the LOD in Supplementary Table 3 was computed are not in the bundle.

Signed QTL effects: Supplementary Table 3 gives the fraction of phenotypic variance explained, not the direction (which parent's allele increases the trait). Figure S3 plots absolute standardized allelic differences, as an image only.
The two-locus interactions (78 pairs counted in Supplementary Table 1) are not listed.
Genotypes, phenotypes and code (on the authors' site, not reachable).
